Description and evidence: The application runtime database role (app_runtime_grp / campussafe_app) holds full table-level UPDATE privileges on app_user, allowing modification of sensitive security attributes including role_id (privilege escalation) and account_status without administrative authorization. Evidence: grp07-campussafe/database/03_roles_and_privileges.sql (Lines 64-65) and information_schema.table_privileges showing table-wide UPDATE.

Foreign key constraints on child tables (report_status_history, maintenance_action, assignment, attachment) specify ON DELETE CASCADE referencing hazard_report. Deleting a parent report permanently wipes out the entire compliance audit trail, technician work logs, and photo evidence. Evidence: grp07-campussafe/database/01_schema.sql (Lines 110, 125, 139, 153) and pg_constraint confdeltype = 'c'.

The database relies solely on application PHP controllers to insert status history records into report_status_history, omitting an automated database trigger on hazard_report. Direct database updates, batch maintenance, or external DBA scripts bypass the audit log entirely. Evidence: database/01_schema.sql and pg_trigger catalog returning 0 rows for user triggers on hazard_report.

Area and activity: Backup Recovery and Disaster Readiness - Activity 6
Description and evidence: The non-superuser backup role campussafe_backup lacks the PostgreSQL pg_read_all_data pre-defined role, risking backup failures when new tables are added. Furthermore, the backup procedure omits global cluster role export (pg_dumpall --globals-only), preventing bare-metal recovery. Evidence: database/03_roles_and_privileges.sql (Lines 80-84) and campusafe/01_backup.ps1.

Area and activity: Schema Normalization and Check Constraints - Activity 3 & 5
Description and evidence: Master table campus_location lacks a composite UNIQUE constraint on (building, floor, room_area), allowing duplicate physical location records to proliferate. Additionally, hazard_report.priority is nullable and not enforced when status = 'Verified', allowing verified reports to bypass triage classification. Evidence: database/01_schema.sql (Lines 66-73, 87-90) and pg_constraint.
